retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, multi-directional radial composition featuring four subjects holding a central optical illusion square against a chaotic Memphis-style geometric background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, symmetrical radial layout where four figures are positioned at 90-degree intervals around a central square. The central square contains a concentric, wavy-lined optical illusion. The background is a dense collage of overlapping squares, triangles, and rectangles in neon hues, overlaid with a fine halftone dot texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry of four subjects around a central focal point
High contrast between dark clothing and neon geometric background
Repetition of geometric shapes creating a sense of organized chaos
Integration of 2D graphic elements with 3D photographic subjects
coreInvariants: Halftone dot pattern overlay on background elements
Neon color palette featuring cyan, magenta, yellow, and lime
Central square with concentric wavy line pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects are placed at the top, bottom, left, and right edges, oriented toward the center, scaled to appear as if holding the central square.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large central square with a multi-colored, wavy concentric line pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central illusion, moves outward to the four faces, and then circulates around the perimeter following the diagonal text and shapes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is 'maximalist' with dense overlapping shapes filling the frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black clothing and text for grounding
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and Lime Green geometric accents
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high value contrast between the subjects and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with irregular, hand-cut edges.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are treated as physical blocks with slight perspective shifts
Terminals are blunt and slightly rounded
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display style repeated in four orientations.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky presence.
To achieve the irregular, jittery edges seen in the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a Memphis-style collage with neon cyan, magenta, and yellow geometric shapes and halftone textures. Place four men in black shirts at 90-degree intervals around a central white square containing a rainbow wavy concentric pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add heavy, blocky, black hand-lettered text in the four corners, rotated 45 degrees to follow the diagonal corners of the frame.

verificationChecks: Are there four subjects in a radial layout?
Is the central square an optical illusion?
Does the background contain halftone dot patterns?
Is the text blocky and oriented diagonally in the corners?

adjustableVariables: Color palette (can shift to pastel or primary)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Verify radial orientation of all four subjects
Ensure central square remains the primary focal point
Check that text does not obscure faces
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial Subject Placement + Memphis Geometric Background + Halftone Overlays + Central Optical Illusion Anchor
